text:
viv.partnerships: Quick thread  Coordinating SI onboarding vouchers with HW partner for the certification pilot. Two asks: 1) confirm voucher redemption flow (hosted vs offline), 2) agree announcement sequencing with partner marketing. Can we align this week?

leo.enablement: I can map the voucher to badge gating. Plan: voucher grants a hosted sandbox + proctored eval attempt. If partner requests offline, voucher redeems for ZIP kit + recorded proctor slot. Will draft flow.

sam.si-ops: From SI ops: need a unique voucher code prefix per partner so we can track usage & support SLAs. Also want a simple API for redemptions we can bake into our SI portal.

rita.hw-partner: HW side: happy to fund 50 vouchers for the pilot. We prefer partners to use hosted sandboxes so we can collect deploy metrics, but air-gapped kits are OK. Also marketing prefers a joint press mention only after 10 successful certs.

ben.ops: Ops constraints: hosted sandboxes require 48h provisioning and dedicated pool capacity must be reserved. If vouchers go live before we reserve, we'll get support tickets. Suggest controlling issuance window until CAP ticket confirmed.

leo.enablement: Proposed sequence: 1) internal dry-run with 3 mentors, 2) open 20 vouchers to SIs (hosted only), 3) run pilot for 2 weeks, 4) collect metrics, 5) joint announcement if >=10 certs and partner OK.

viv.partnerships: That sequence works. Couple of follow-ups: Rita, can you confirm partner marketing's 10-cert threshold in writing? Sam, can you outline the redemption API schema? Ben, can you file CAP for voucher pool & sandbox capacity?

sam.si-ops: Redemption API sketch: ```json
{ "code": "RITA-XXXX", "partner": "rita-hw", "type": "hosted|offline", "redeemer_email": "user@si.com" }
```

sam.si-ops: We'll also emit webhook on successful deploy.

rita.hw-partner: Confirming: marketing wants 10 certified SI completions before public announcement. We'll send an email to viv with a short confirmation.

ben.ops: Filing CAP-12045 to reserve 25 sandbox seats and mark maintenance windows. ETA 48h. Will tag this thread.

leo.enablement: I'll add voucher redemption steps to the playbook and include offline kit instructions for air-gapped cases. Also adding a small clause on recordings/consent.

notifier-bot: Reminder  Dedicated maintenance Sun 03:00 UTC may affect sandbox provisioning.

viv.partnerships: Next steps recap: Rita -> written confirmation of announcement threshold; Sam -> redemption API + webhook spec; Ben -> CAP-12045 ticket; Leo -> playbook update & voucher mapping. I'll coordinate a short 20m call Thu 10am PT to approve wording before vouchers go live. Thanks all!
